hosting.treatment: Embedded lease under ASC 842-10-15-3 to 15-20 (library/asc842_identification.md): dedicated servers identified by serial number, exclusive use, no substitution without customer consent, customer directs workloads; power/cooling/network are non-lease components. ROU asset and lease liability recognized at commencement (2025-10-01) at the PV of 36 monthly $18,000 payments = $574,413 at the ASSUMED 8% annual discount rate (rate unverified; see revenue_memo.md; at 6% = $591,678, at 10% = $557,842). At 2025-12-31 both = $531,617 (Q4 interest $11,204; assumed straight-line Q4 expense $54,000 with no net-income change; front-loaded pattern would give expense $59,072 and net loss $239,072).

going_concern.disclosure: ASC 205-40-50-1 to 50-14 (library/asc205_40_going_concern.md). Substantial doubt exists about the Company's ability to continue as a going concern within one year after issuance of the 2025 financial statements: the 13-week cash flow projection (documents/13_week_cash_flow.csv, verified week by week) shows the $612,000 opening balance exhausted during the week ending 2026-02-20 (first negative ending balance -105,000) and a cumulative shortfall of $509,000 by 2026-03-27 absent new financing; ending cash is negative in 6 of the 13 weeks. Management's principal mitigating plan, a $3.0M bridge note from Crestline Ventures, is a NON-BINDING term sheet (target close 2026-01-31) subject to conditions precedent including audited/reviewed Q4 2025 revenue of at least $1,500,000, which the Company does not meet (corrected Q4 revenue is $850,000) and there being no going-concern qualification; a non-binding term sheet with conditions precedent is not a probable plan, and the condition depends on revenue the Company cannot recognize under ASC 606 (Halvorsen LOI and Saltline bill-and-hold reversed; see revenue_memo.md); a plan is considered only if it is probable that it will be effectively implemented and probable that it will mitigate the conditions, and no other plans that meet that threshold have been identified. Management discloses that substantial doubt exists and that its plans are not expected to alleviate it, as required by ASC 205-40-50.
